The TechRepublic WordPress REST API provides JSON endpoints for accessing posts, pages, categories, tags, authors, media, and other content types published on TechRepublic.com. Built on the standard WordPress REST API framework, it supports filtering, pagination, and full-text search across all TechRepublic technology news and analysis content.
